svg.title: \begin{aligned} |D_{\rm mat}| &:=\left|L^3\log z_{r,n_*}-\log z_{r,Ln_*}\right| \le L^3\varepsilon_P(R_*)+\varepsilon_P(LR_*) \\[0pt] &\le (L^3+1) \left[\varepsilon_5(\bar mR_*) +3e_K^{1/4-9\varepsilon}\right] \le C_{\rm mat},\\[0pt] C_{\rm mat}&=(L^3+1)\bigl(\varepsilon_5(1/L)+1\bigr). \end{aligned} \tag{5}
